notes.title: Fixes and new sprint effect. Update 2024.06.12.
notes.content:
Greetings folks!
A completely sudden update with fixes and small improvements!

[list]
[*] - Fixes some bugs in the "Catacombs" location
[*] - Added to Settings Menu: There is now an option to enable/disable holiday events. Allows you to disable Halloween and Christmas themed hats.
[*] - Added to Settings Menu: Auto Play Comics. Some may think that auto-playing comic book page changes is not a good thing. You can now turn this off.
[*] - Fixed visual bug with 1 million gold achievement.

[*] - Updated sprint effect. Now spends 50% less mana. Added sound and changed visual effect.
[*] - Fixed bug with teleportation to obelisk when hero was standing close to it.
[*] - Fixed a bug when closing the game with Cyclopaedia enabled.
[*] - Changed the "task marker" in the Flatland location near the blue barrier.
[*] - Added visual and audio effect for the blue barrier.
[/list].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27500760/b94277272fc66fb5da927433d60e1df8d7e883ce.png[/img]

[b]Thank you all for your attention![/b].

notes.title: Big update!
notes.content:
Hello players!

I'll be brief - this is a major update!
This game hasn't had an update for a long time, but it has continued to evolve.

And now item by item:
[list]
[*] [b]Game engine update.[/b]
[i]Migration from GameMaker:Studio 1.4 to GameMaker 2022[/i]
[*] [b]Gamepad control has been improved.[/b]
[i]Button icons are now displayed instead of text[/i].
[*] [b]Minimap of the locations has been drawn.[/b]
[i]I had to painstakingly draw mini maps for all locations![/i]
[*] [b]Changed menus[/b]
[*] [b]Added Achievements, Settings and Cyclopedia submenu in the Pause menu![/b]
[*] [b]Bug fixes[/b]
[*] [b]Completely changed savegames[/b]!
[i]It was not as easy as I thought it would be.[/i]
[*] [b]There's a roll![/b]
[/list]

And now with screenshots!
[list]
[*] [b]Gamepad control has been improved.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27500760/abeaf9d40583ad54334faf5b79a061d470570b56.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27500760/18b60800ad50603c3df9bb8addb4683c23b54c40.png[/img]

[*] [b]Minimap of the locations has been drawn.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27500760/5ee1911491e2cae9e3e4d571391c406be48dd911.png[/img]

[*] [b]Changed menus[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27500760/ea38e5bf4069283af9e3f5bf2e3118387db59eda.png[/img]

[*] [b]Added Achievements, Settings and Cyclopedia submenu in the Pause menu![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27500760/67b75e29b946bc109f2ef5345b7a2666cddaef4b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27500760/69aafc9e53c7ab92a1829e1cf0644486296a63b6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27500760/69309b67bec449cd62fbf6617aa1f3c815d91738.png[/img]

[/list]

A small addition on the saves:
I tried very hard to make the old saves compatible with the new ones and the tests showed that it worked. But tests are not real player experiences, so forgive me if you can't get your old progress into the new version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27500760/7050e80d35467b81921997ecc10a300a092d5ff7.png[/img]
[b]Valve[/b] tested the [i]old[/i] version of the game on SteamDeck and the game got the "playable" status! Yay!
But with the release of the new version, you'll need to submit the game for testing again! That's how it coincided, eh, if only a little later!

I'm also pleased to announce that the game will be available from [b]July 14[/b] on the [b]Nintendo Switch[/b] gaming platform! And will be back on sale on [b]Xbox One[/b] - yes, it was available there too!

Thank you all for your attention and for showing interest in the game!

notes.title: Update! Added Ukrainian translation!
notes.content:
Now the adventures of Vzerthos are fully available in Ukrainian!
Also the latest changes and updates:
- Fixed minor bugs
- Added achievements "Collect 100k gold", 150k, 250k, 500k, 750k.
- Added a new sub-type of deadwalkers to "dungeon level 3"
- Fixed achievements of bosses and one secret achievement - "Dragon in the Tower".

notes.title: Keybinds and Task Markers Update
notes.content:
The new update includes:
[list]
	[*] [b]KEYBINDS[/b]
	- Now you are able to customize your keyboard controls and configure your controller sticks' sensitivity and set up a deadzone in the Settings menu.

	[*] [b]TASK MARKERS[/b]
	- Now you can also toggle the Task Markers that will show you the correct route and help you not to get lost while progressing the storyline.
[/list]
